lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Visible as multiple horizontal tiers of high-luminance circular pixel clusters. The primary mid-lateral row contains approximately 10-12 distinct nodes spaced at regular intervals posterior to the gill slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, forming a grid-like arrangement where the circular blobs act as the high-intensity intersection nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the lateral flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient transition with high pixel intensity on the upper edge and shadowing on the lower edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin displays a sparse distribution of approximately 15 high-luminance blobs, primarily localized in the posterior two-thirds of the fin's lateral surface area.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple small, low-luminance elongated objects (likely commensal fish) attached to the ventral surface and trailing near the pelvic and pectoral fins.
